title: Recent advances in the design and fabrication of ZnIn2S4-based photocatalysts for photocatalytic CO2 reduction into value-added chemicals
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01033K, Review Article
Li Wang, Longfu Wei, Qizhe Fan, Changlin Yu
This review focuses on the design and fabrication of ZnIn2S4-based photocatalysts and their recent progress in photocatalytic CO2 reduction to value-added chemicals.
